name: Shashikant Giri
HeadLine: Web Developer & Data Analyst | Next.js, React.js, Node.js, MongoDB | Power BI, Python, SQL, Excel | Building Data-Driven Web Applications | Open to Opportunities
Info: I'm a Web Developer and Data Analyst based in Navi Mumbai, graduating in 2026 with a B.Sc. in Information Technology from Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj University. Over the past year, I've built 9 live projects — from a crowdfunding platform (GetMyChap) with QR-based payment integration to a Hospital Performance Dashboard analyzing patient satisfaction and operational KPIs using Power BI. What makes me different: I don't just write code — I connect web technology with data insights. Whether it's building a responsive Next.js app with MongoDB/Supabase or designing a Power BI dashboard from raw Excel data, I focus on solutions that drive real decisions. I'm currently pursuing a Data Science with AIML certification (Coder Technologies, 2026) and actively looking for entry-level opportunities in Web Development, Data Analytics, or Full Stack Development.
Mission: To bridge the gap between technology and data by developing intelligent, scalable, and user-focused digital solutions. My goal is to leverage web development and data analytics to help organizations make informed decisions, improve efficiency, and deliver impactful user experiences.
Career_Objective: To begin my professional career as a Web Developer or Data Analyst where I can apply my technical, analytical, and problem-solving skills to create innovative solutions while continuously growing as a technology professional.
